svg.data-spec:
title: Controller kind: flow dir: down
[Controller] teal right watch: Watches | one per kind queue: Work queue | each key once worker: Worker | one pass at a time rec: Reconcilers | one per kind [/]
[Storage layer] coral meta: Metastore @db [/]
dp: Data plane | routes, workers, stores @blue gc: Owner collector | sweep every 5 min @teal
watch > queue > worker > rec meta ~> watch: events rec > meta: status rec > dp meta <> gc: watch, delete orphans
